summary: Enhance your research skills with our NVivo course. Learn qualitative data analysis and visualization techniques to elevate your data insights effectively.
lede: Qualitative data analysis with NVivo helps researchers organize source material and link evidence to reported findings. Designed for professionals already working with qualitative evidence, it covers codebook development, thematic and framework analysis, case comparison through matrix coding queries, and visualization of relationships. Participants also practice documenting analytic decisions and reporting findings without overstating what the data can support.
audienceIntro: This qualitative data analysis course is for professionals who already work with qualitative evidence and want stronger NVivo workflows, analytic rigour, and visual reporting capability.
prerequisites: You should have working experience with qualitative research, interviews, focus groups, observations, document review, or open-ended survey data. No programming is required. You should bring a research question or a representative sample of anonymized qualitative material if permitted by your organization. Advanced NVivo functions, automated coding, and AI-assisted workflows receive operational application rather than technical engineering treatment.
